CREATE TABLE cards (

    id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    artist TEXT -- Column Description: The name of the artist that illustrated the card art.,
    asciiName TEXT -- Column Description: The ASCII(opens new window) (Basic/128) code formatted card name with no special unicode characters.,
    availability TEXT -- Column Description: A list of the card's available printing types., Column Value Explanation: "arena", "dreamcast", "mtgo", "paper", "shandalar",
    borderColor TEXT -- Column Description: The color of the card border., Column Value Explanation: "black", "borderless", "gold", "silver", "white",
    cardKingdomFoilId TEXT -- Column Description: card Kingdom Foil Id, Column Value Explanation: cardKingdomFoilId, when paired with cardKingdomId that is not Null, is incredibly powerful.,
    cardKingdomId TEXT -- Column Description: card Kingdom Id, Column Value Explanation: A list of all the colors in the color indicator,
    colorIdentity TEXT -- Column Description: A list of all the colors found in manaCost, colorIndicator, and text,
    colorIndicator TEXT -- Column Description: A list of all the colors in the color indicator (The symbol prefixed to a card's types).,
    colors TEXT -- Column Description: A list of all the colors in manaCost and colorIndicator., Column Value Explanation: Some cards may not have values, such as cards with "Devoid" in its text.,
    convertedManaCost REAL -- Column Description: The converted mana cost of the card. Use the manaValue property., Column Value Explanation: if value is higher, it means that this card cost more converted mana,
    duelDeck TEXT -- Column Description: The indicator for which duel deck the card is in.,
    edhrecRank INTEGER -- Column Description: The card rank on EDHRec,
    faceConvertedManaCost REAL -- Column Description: The converted mana cost or mana value for the face for either half or part of the card., Column Value Explanation: if value is higher, it means that this card cost more converted mana for the face,
    faceName TEXT -- Column Description: The name on the face of the card.,
    flavorName TEXT -- Column Description: The promotional card name printed above the true card name on special cards that has no game function., Column Value Explanation: The promotional card name printed above the true card name on special cards that has no game function.,
    flavorText TEXT -- Column Description: The italicized text found below the rules text that has no game function., Column Value Explanation: The italicized text found below the rules text that has no game function.,
    frameEffects TEXT -- Column Description: The visual frame effects., Column Value Explanation: "colorshifted", "companion", "compasslanddfc", "devoid", "draft", "etched", "extendedart", "fullart", "inverted", "legendary", "lesson", "miracle", "mooneldrazidfc", "nyxtouched", "originpwdfc", "showcase", "snow", "sunmoondfc", "textless", "tombstone", "waxingandwaningmoondfc",
    frameVersion TEXT -- Column Description: The version of the card frame style., Column Value Explanation: "1993", "1997", "2003", "2015", "future",
    hand TEXT -- Column Description: The starting maximum hand size total modifier., Column Value Explanation: A + or - character precedes an integer.   positive maximum hand size => +1, +2, .... negative maximum hand size => -1, .... neural maximum hand size => 0....,
    hasAlternativeDeckLimit INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the card allows a value other than 4 copies in a deck., Column Value Explanation: 0: disallow 1: allow,
    hasContentWarning INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the card marked by Wizards of the Coast (opens new window) for having sensitive content. See this official article (opens new window) for more information., Column Value Explanation: 0: doesn't have 1: has sensitve content or Wizards of the Coast  Cards with this property may have missing or degraded properties and values.,
    hasFoil INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the card can be found in foil, Column Value Explanation: 0: cannot be found 1: can be found,
    hasNonFoil INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the card can be found in non-foil, Column Value Explanation: 0: cannot be found 1: can be found,
    isAlternative INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the card is an alternate variation to an original printing, Column Value Explanation: 0: is not 1: is,
    isFullArt INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the card has full artwork., Column Value Explanation: 0: doesn't have, 1: has full artwork,
    isOnlineOnly INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the card is only available in online game variations., Column Value Explanation: 0: is not 1: is,
    isOversized INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the card is oversized., Column Value Explanation: 0: is not 1: is,
    isPromo INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the card is a promotional printing., Column Value Explanation: 0: is not 1: is,
    isReprint INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the card has been reprinted., Column Value Explanation: 0: has not 1: has not been,
    isReserved INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the card is on the Magic: The Gathering Reserved List (opens new window), Column Value Explanation: If the card is on the Magic, it will appear in The Gathering Reserved List,
    isStarter INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the card is found in a starter deck such as Planeswalker/Brawl decks., Column Value Explanation: 0: is not 1: is,
    isStorySpotlight INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the card is a Story Spotlight card., Column Value Explanation: 0: is not 1: is,
    isTextless INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the card does not have a text box., Column Value Explanation: 0: has a text box; 1: doesn't have a text box;,
    isTimeshifted INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the card is time shifted, Column Value Explanation: If the card is "timeshifted", a feature of certain sets where a card will have a different frameVersion.,
    keywords TEXT -- Column Description: A list of keywords found on the card.,
    layout TEXT -- Column Description: The type of card layout. For a token card, this will be "token",
    leadershipSkills TEXT -- Column Description: A list of formats the card is legal to be a commander in,
    life TEXT -- Column Description: The starting life total modifier. A plus or minus character precedes an integer.,
    loyalty TEXT -- Column Description: The starting loyalty value of the card., Column Value Explanation: Used only on cards with "Planeswalker" in its types. empty means unkown,
    manaCost TEXT -- Column Description: The mana cost of the card wrapped in brackets for each value., Column Value Explanation: manaCost is unconverted mana cost,
    mcmId TEXT,
    mcmMetaId TEXT,
    mtgArenaId TEXT,
    mtgjsonV4Id TEXT,
    mtgoFoilId TEXT,
    mtgoId TEXT,
    multiverseId TEXT,
    name TEXT -- Column Description: The name of the card., Column Value Explanation: Cards with multiple faces, like "Split" and "Meld" cards are given a delimiter.,
    number TEXT -- Column Description: The number of the card,
    originalReleaseDate TEXT -- Column Description: original Release Date, Column Value Explanation: The original release date in ISO 8601(opens new window) format for a promotional card printed outside of a cycle window, such as Secret Lair Drop promotions.,

【Schema】
# Table: cards
[
(id:INTEGER, Primary Key, Examples: [41138, 1349, 23810, 6241, 29566]),
(artist:TEXT, Description: The name of the artist that illustrated the card art., Examples: [Pete Venters, Volkan Baǵa, Justin Sweet, Matthew D. Wilson, Rebecca Guay]),
(asciiName:TEXT, Description: The ASCII(opens new window) (Basic/128) code formatted card name with no special unicode characters., Examples: [El-Hajjaj, Junun Efreet, Dandan, Ghazban Ogre]),
(availability:TEXT, Description: A list of the card's available printing types. Value Explanation: "arena", "dreamcast", "mtgo", "paper", "shandalar", Examples: [mtgo,paper, paper, arena, arena,mtgo,paper, arena,paper]),
(borderColor:TEXT, Description: The color of the card border. Value Explanation: "black", "borderless", "gold", "silver", "white", Examples: [black, white, borderless, silver, gold]),
(cardKingdomFoilId:TEXT, Description: card Kingdom Foil Id Value Explanation: cardKingdomFoilId, when paired with cardKingdomId that is not Null, is incredibly powerful., Examples: [123094, 123095, 123096, 123097]),
(cardKingdomId:TEXT, Description: card Kingdom Id Value Explanation: A list of all the colors in the color indicator, Examples: [122719, 122720, 122725, 122726, 122727]),
(colorIdentity:TEXT, Description: A list of all the colors found in manaCost, colorIndicator, and text, Examples: [W, B, U, R, G]),
(colorIndicator:TEXT, Description: A list of all the colors in the color indicator (The symbol prefixed to a card's types)., Examples: [U, G, R, B]),
(colors:TEXT, Description: A list of all the colors in manaCost and colorIndicator. Value Explanation: Some cards may not have values, such as cards with "Devoid" in its text., Examples: [W, B, U, R, G]),
(convertedManaCost:REAL, Description: The converted mana cost of the card. Use the manaValue property. Value Explanation: if value is higher, it means that this card cost more converted mana, Examples: [7.0, 5.0, 4.0, 1.0, 6.0]),
(duelDeck:TEXT, Description: The indicator for which duel deck the card is in., Examples: [a, b]),
(edhrecRank:INTEGER, Description: The card rank on EDHRec, Examples: [15650, 12702, 11081, 12901, 3988]),
(faceConvertedManaCost:REAL, Description: The converted mana cost or mana value for the face for either half or part of the card. Value Explanation: if value is higher, it means that this card cost more converted mana for the face, Examples: [4.0, 5.0, 6.0, 3.0]),
(faceName:TEXT, Description: The name on the face of the card., Examples: [Dusk, Dawn, Commit, Memory]),
(flavorName:TEXT, Description: The promotional card name printed above the true card name on special cards that has no game function. Value Explanation: The promotional card name printed above the true card name on special cards that has no game function., Examples: [Godzilla, King of the Monsters]),
(flavorText:TEXT, Description: The italicized text found below the rules text that has no game function. Value Explanation: The italicized text found below the rules text that has no game function.),
(frameEffects:TEXT, Description: The visual frame effects. Value Explanation: "colorshifted", "companion", "compasslanddfc", "devoid", "draft", "etched", "extendedart", "fullart", "inverted", "legendary", "lesson", "miracle", "mooneldrazidfc", "nyxtouched", "originpwdfc", "showcase", "snow", "sunmoondfc", "textless", "tombstone", "waxingandwaningmoondfc", Examples: [legendary, nyxtouched, miracle, devoid]),
(frameVersion:TEXT, Description: The version of the card frame style. Value Explanation: "1993", "1997", "2003", "2015", "future", Examples: [2003, 1993, 2015, 1997, future]),
(hand:TEXT, Description: The starting maximum hand size total modifier. Value Explanation: A + or - character precedes an integer.   positive maximum hand size => +1, +2, .... negative maximum hand size => -1, .... neural maximum hand size => 0...., Examples: [1, 0, -2, -1]),
(hasAlternativeDeckLimit:INTEGER, Description: If the card allows a value other than 4 copies in a deck. Value Explanation: 0: disallow 1: allow, Examples: [0, 1]),
(hasContentWarning:INTEGER, Description: If the card marked by Wizards of the Coast (opens new window) for having sensitive content. See this official article (opens new window) for more information. Value Explanation: 0: doesn't have 1: has sensitve content or Wizards of the Coast  Cards with this property may have missing or degraded properties and values., Examples: [0, 1]),
(hasFoil:INTEGER, Description: If the card can be found in foil Value Explanation: 0: cannot be found 1: can be found, Examples: [0, 1]),
(hasNonFoil:INTEGER, Description: If the card can be found in non-foil Value Explanation: 0: cannot be found 1: can be found, Examples: [1, 0]),
(isAlternative:INTEGER, Description: If the card is an alternate variation to an original printing Value Explanation: 0: is not 1: is, Examples: [0, 1]),
(isFullArt:INTEGER, Description: If the card has full artwork. Value Explanation: 0: doesn't have, 1: has full artwork, Examples: [0, 1]),
(isOnlineOnly:INTEGER, Description: If the card is only available in online game variations. Value Explanation: 0: is not 1: is, Examples: [0, 1]),
(isOversized:INTEGER, Description: If the card is oversized. Value Explanation: 0: is not 1: is, Examples: [0, 1]),
(isPromo:INTEGER, Description: If the card is a promotional printing. Value Explanation: 0: is not 1: is, Examples: [0, 1]),
(isReprint:INTEGER, Description: If the card has been reprinted. Value Explanation: 0: has not 1: has not been, Examples: [1, 0]),
(isReserved:INTEGER, Description: If the card is on the Magic: The Gathering Reserved List (opens new window) Value Explanation: If the card is on the Magic, it will appear in The Gathering Reserved List, Examples: [0, 1]),
(isStarter:INTEGER, Description: If the card is found in a starter deck such as Planeswalker/Brawl decks. Value Explanation: 0: is not 1: is, Examples: [0, 1]),
(isStorySpotlight:INTEGER, Description: If the card is a Story Spotlight card. Value Explanation: 0: is not 1: is, Examples: [0, 1]),
(isTextless:INTEGER, Description: If the card does not have a text box. Value Explanation: 0: has a text box; 1: doesn't have a text box;, Examples: [0, 1]),
(isTimeshifted:INTEGER, Description: If the card is time shifted Value Explanation: If the card is "timeshifted", a feature of certain sets where a card will have a different frameVersion., Examples: [0, 1]),
(keywords:TEXT, Description: A list of keywords found on the card., Examples: [First strike, Flying, First strike,Flash, Enchant]),
(layout:TEXT, Description: The type of card layout. For a token card, this will be "token", Examples: [normal, aftermath, split, flip, leveler]),
(leadershipSkills:TEXT, Description: A list of formats the card is legal to be a commander in),
(life:TEXT, Description: The starting life total modifier. A plus or minus character precedes an integer., Examples: [-5, -1, 2, 5]),
(loyalty:TEXT, Description: The starting loyalty value of the card. Value Explanation: Used only on cards with "Planeswalker" in its types. empty means unkown, Examples: [6, 3, 4, 5]),
(manaCost:TEXT, Description: The mana cost of the card wrapped in brackets for each value. Value Explanation: manaCost is unconverted mana cost, Examples: [{5}{W}{W}, {4}{W}, {3}{W}, {W}, {5}{W}]),
(mcmId:TEXT, Examples: [16165, 16166, 16171, 16172, 16173]),
(mcmMetaId:TEXT, Examples: [156, 176, 368, 423, 432]),
(mtgArenaId:TEXT, Examples: [74983, 74986, 74987, 74993]),
(mtgjsonV4Id:TEXT, Examples: [ad41be73-582f-58ed-abd4-a88c1f616ac3]),
(mtgoFoilId:TEXT, Examples: [27501, 26993, 27473, 27327, 27095]),
(mtgoId:TEXT, Examples: [27500, 26992, 27472, 27326, 27094]),
(multiverseId:TEXT, Examples: [130550, 129465, 129470, 129477, 132106]),
(name:TEXT, Description: The name of the card. Value Explanation: Cards with multiple faces, like "Split" and "Meld" cards are given a delimiter., Examples: [Ancestor's Chosen, Angel of Mercy, Aven Cloudchaser, Ballista Squad, Bandage]),
(number:TEXT, Description: The number of the card, Examples: [1, 2, 7, 8, 9]),
(originalReleaseDate:TEXT, Description: original Release Date Value Explanation: The original release date in ISO 8601(opens new window) format for a promotional card printed outside of a cycle window, such as Secret Lair Drop promotions., Examples: [2012/12/1, 2006/12/1, 2007/12/1, 2009/12/1]),
(originalText:TEXT, Description: original Text Value Explanation: The text on the card as originally printed.),
(originalType:TEXT, Description: original Type Value Explanation: The type of the card as originally printed. Includes any supertypes and subtypes., Examples: [Creature - Human Cleric]),
(otherFaceIds:TEXT, Description: other Face Ids Value Explanation: A list of card UUID's to this card's counterparts, such as transformed or melded faces., Examples: [87f0062a-8321-5c16-960e-a12ce1df5839]),
(power:TEXT, Description: The power of the card. Value Explanation: ∞ means infinite power / null or * refers to unknown power, Examples: [4, 3, 2, 1]),
(printings:TEXT, Description: A list of set printing codes the card was printed in, formatted in uppercase.),
(promoTypes:TEXT, Description: A list of promotional types for a card. Value Explanation: "arenaleague", "boosterfun", "boxtopper", "brawldeck", "bundle", "buyabox", "convention", "datestamped", "draculaseries", "draftweekend", "duels", "event", "fnm", "gameday", "gateway", "giftbox", "gilded", "godzillaseries", "instore", "intropack", "jpwalker", "judgegift", "league", "mediainsert", "neonink", "openhouse", "planeswalkerstamped", "playerrewards", "playpromo", "premiereshop", "prerelease", "promopack", "release", "setpromo", "stamped", "textured", "themepack", "thick", "tourney", "wizardsplaynetwork", Examples: [boxtopper,boosterfun, boosterfun, release,buyabox, intropack]),
(purchaseUrls:TEXT, Description: Links that navigate to websites where the card can be purchased.),
(rarity:TEXT, Description: The card printing rarity., Examples: [uncommon, common, rare, mythic]),
(scryfallId:TEXT, Examples: [7a5cd03c-4227-4551-aa4b-7d119f0468b5]),
(scryfallIllustrationId:TEXT, Examples: [be2f7173-c8b7-4172-a388-9b2c6b3c16e5]),
(scryfallOracleId:TEXT, Examples: [fc2ccab7-cab1-4463-b73d-898070136d74]),
(setCode:TEXT, Description: The set printing code that the card is from., Examples: [10E, 2ED, 2XM, 3ED, 4BB]),
(side:TEXT, Description: The identifier of the card side. Value Explanation: Used on cards with multiple faces on the same card.  if this value is empty, then it means this card doesn't have multiple faces on the same card., Examples: [a, b, c, d]),
(subtypes:TEXT, Description: A list of card subtypes found after em-dash., Examples: [Human,Cleric, Angel, Bird,Soldier, Human,Rebel]),
(supertypes:TEXT, Description: A list of card supertypes found before em-dash. Value Explanation: list of all types should be the union of subtypes and supertypes, Examples: [Legendary, Basic, Legendary,Snow, World]),
(tcgplayerProductId:TEXT, Examples: [15032, 15033, 15045, 15048, 15049]),
(text:TEXT, Description: The rules text of the card.),
(toughness:TEXT, Description: The toughness of the card., Examples: [4, 3, 2, 1]),
(type:TEXT, Description: The type of the card as visible, including any supertypes and subtypes. Value Explanation: "Artifact", "Card", "Conspiracy", "Creature", "Dragon", "Dungeon", "Eaturecray", "Elemental", "Elite", "Emblem", "Enchantment", "Ever", "Goblin", "Hero", "Instant", "Jaguar", "Knights", "Land", "Phenomenon", "Plane", "Planeswalker", "Scariest", "Scheme", "See", "Sorcery", "Sticker", "Summon", "Token", "Tribal", "Vanguard", "Wolf", "You’ll", "instant", Examples: [Creature — Human Cleric]),
(types:TEXT, Description: A list of all card types of the card, including Un‑sets and gameplay variants., Examples: [Creature, Instant, Enchantment, Sorcery, Artifact]),
(uuid:TEXT, Description: The universal unique identifier (v5) generated by MTGJSON. Each entry is unique., Examples: [00010d56-fe38-5e35-8aed-518019aa36a5]),
(variations:TEXT, Examples: [b7c19924-b4bf-56fc-aa73-f586e940bd42]),
(watermark:TEXT, Description: The name of the watermark on the card., Examples: [set (HOU), set (LGN), set (ONS), set (USG)])
]

[
(id:INTEGER, Description: unique id number identifying this row of data, Primary Key, Examples: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]),
(flavorText:TEXT, Description: The foreign flavor text of the card.),

schema_representation.execution_plan: Execution plan: The question asks for the foreign name and type of a card that has an 'abzan' watermark. To achieve this, I need to join the `cards` table (to filter by watermark) with the `foreign_data` table (to get the foreign name and type). The `cards.watermark` column is used to filter for 'abzan'. The `foreign_data.name` column will provide the foreign name, and the `foreign_data.type` column will provide the card type. The `uuid` column is essential for joining these two tables.

sql_exec_info.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  T2."name",
  T2."type"
FROM cards AS T1
INNER JOIN foreign_data AS T2
  ON T1."uuid" = T2."uuid"
WHERE
  T1."watermark" = 'abzan';

CREATE TABLE cards (

    id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    artist TEXT -- Column Description: The name of the artist that illustrated the card art.,
    asciiName TEXT -- Column Description: The ASCII(opens new window) (Basic/128) code formatted card name with no special unicode characters.,
    availability TEXT -- Column Description: A list of the card's available printing types., Column Value Explanation: "arena", "dreamcast", "mtgo", "paper", "shandalar",
    borderColor TEXT -- Column Description: The color of the card border., Column Value Explanation: "black", "borderless", "gold", "silver", "white",
    cardKingdomFoilId TEXT -- Column Description: card Kingdom Foil Id, Column Value Explanation: cardKingdomFoilId, when paired with cardKingdomId that is not Null, is incredibly powerful.,
    cardKingdomId TEXT -- Column Description: card Kingdom Id, Column Value Explanation: A list of all the colors in the color indicator,
    colorIdentity TEXT -- Column Description: A list of all the colors found in manaCost, colorIndicator, and text,
    colorIndicator TEXT -- Column Description: A list of all the colors in the color indicator (The symbol prefixed to a card's types).,
    colors TEXT -- Column Description: A list of all the colors in manaCost and colorIndicator., Column Value Explanation: Some cards may not have values, such as cards with "Devoid" in its text.,
    convertedManaCost REAL -- Column Description: The converted mana cost of the card. Use the manaValue property., Column Value Explanation: if value is higher, it means that this card cost more converted mana,
    duelDeck TEXT -- Column Description: The indicator for which duel deck the card is in.,
    edhrecRank INTEGER -- Column Description: The card rank on EDHRec,
    faceConvertedManaCost REAL -- Column Description: The converted mana cost or mana value for the face for either half or part of the card., Column Value Explanation: if value is higher, it means that this card cost more converted mana for the face,
    faceName TEXT -- Column Description: The name on the face of the card.,
    flavorName TEXT -- Column Description: The promotional card name printed above the true card name on special cards that has no game function., Column Value Explanation: The promotional card name printed above the true card name on special cards that has no game function.,
    flavorText TEXT -- Column Description: The italicized text found below the rules text that has no game function., Column Value Explanation: The italicized text found below the rules text that has no game function.,
    frameEffects TEXT -- Column Description: The visual frame effects., Column Value Explanation: "colorshifted", "companion", "compasslanddfc", "devoid", "draft", "etched", "extendedart", "fullart", "inverted", "legendary", "lesson", "miracle", "mooneldrazidfc", "nyxtouched", "originpwdfc", "showcase", "snow", "sunmoondfc", "textless", "tombstone", "waxingandwaningmoondfc",
    frameVersion TEXT -- Column Description: The version of the card frame style., Column Value Explanation: "1993", "1997", "2003", "2015", "future",
    hand TEXT -- Column Description: The starting maximum hand size total modifier., Column Value Explanation: A + or - character precedes an integer.   positive maximum hand size => +1, +2, .... negative maximum hand size => -1, .... neural maximum hand size => 0....,
    hasAlternativeDeckLimit INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the card allows a value other than 4 copies in a deck., Column Value Explanation: 0: disallow 1: allow,
    hasContentWarning INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the card marked by Wizards of the Coast (opens new window) for having sensitive content. See this official article (opens new window) for more information., Column Value Explanation: 0: doesn't have 1: has sensitve content or Wizards of the Coast  Cards with this property may have missing or degraded properties and values.,
    hasFoil INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the card can be found in foil, Column Value Explanation: 0: cannot be found 1: can be found,
    hasNonFoil INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the card can be found in non-foil, Column Value Explanation: 0: cannot be found 1: can be found,
    isAlternative INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the card is an alternate variation to an original printing, Column Value Explanation: 0: is not 1: is,
    isFullArt INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the card has full artwork., Column Value Explanation: 0: doesn't have, 1: has full artwork,
    isOnlineOnly INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the card is only available in online game variations., Column Value Explanation: 0: is not 1: is,
    isOversized INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the card is oversized., Column Value Explanation: 0: is not 1: is,
    isPromo INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the card is a promotional printing., Column Value Explanation: 0: is not 1: is,
    isReprint INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the card has been reprinted., Column Value Explanation: 0: has not 1: has not been,
    isReserved INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the card is on the Magic: The Gathering Reserved List (opens new window), Column Value Explanation: If the card is on the Magic, it will appear in The Gathering Reserved List,
    isStarter INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the card is found in a starter deck such as Planeswalker/Brawl decks., Column Value Explanation: 0: is not 1: is,
    isStorySpotlight INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the card is a Story Spotlight card., Column Value Explanation: 0: is not 1: is,
    isTextless INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the card does not have a text box., Column Value Explanation: 0: has a text box; 1: doesn't have a text box;,
    isTimeshifted INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the card is time shifted, Column Value Explanation: If the card is "timeshifted", a feature of certain sets where a card will have a different frameVersion.,
    keywords TEXT -- Column Description: A list of keywords found on the card.,
    layout TEXT -- Column Description: The type of card layout. For a token card, this will be "token",
    leadershipSkills TEXT -- Column Description: A list of formats the card is legal to be a commander in,
    life TEXT -- Column Description: The starting life total modifier. A plus or minus character precedes an integer.,
    loyalty TEXT -- Column Description: The starting loyalty value of the card., Column Value Explanation: Used only on cards with "Planeswalker" in its types. empty means unkown,
    manaCost TEXT -- Column Description: The mana cost of the card wrapped in brackets for each value., Column Value Explanation: manaCost is unconverted mana cost,
    mcmId TEXT,
    mcmMetaId TEXT,
    mtgArenaId TEXT,
    mtgjsonV4Id TEXT,
    mtgoFoilId TEXT,
    mtgoId TEXT,
    multiverseId TEXT,
    name TEXT -- Column Description: The name of the card., Column Value Explanation: Cards with multiple faces, like "Split" and "Meld" cards are given a delimiter.,
    number TEXT -- Column Description: The number of the card,
    originalReleaseDate TEXT -- Column Description: original Release Date, Column Value Explanation: The original release date in ISO 8601(opens new window) format for a promotional card printed outside of a cycle window, such as Secret Lair Drop promotions.,
    originalText TEXT -- Column Description: original Text, Column Value Explanation: The text on the card as originally printed.,
    originalType TEXT -- Column Description: original Type, Column Value Explanation: The type of the card as originally printed. Includes any supertypes and subtypes.,
    otherFaceIds TEXT -- Column Description: other Face Ids, Column Value Explanation: A list of card UUID's to this card's counterparts, such as transformed or melded faces.,
    power TEXT -- Column Description: The power of the card., Column Value Explanation: ∞ means infinite power / null or * refers to unknown power,
    printings TEXT -- Column Description: A list of set printing codes the card was printed in, formatted in uppercase.,

The `cards.watermark` column is used to filter for 'abzan'. The `foreign_data.name` column will provide the foreign name, and the `foreign_data.type` column will provide the card type. The `uuid` column is essential for joining these two tables.

sql_exec_info.sql: SELECT T1.name, T1.type FROM foreign_data AS T1 INNER JOIN cards AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T2.watermark = 'abzan'

sql_exec_info.sql: SELECT COUNT(T1."id") FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN sets AS T2 ON T1."setCode" = T2."code" WHERE T2."name" = 'Coldsnap' AND T1."convertedManaCost" > 5 AND (T1."power" = '*' OR T1."power" IS NULL)

This requires information from the 'cards' and 'sets' tables. Specifically, we need to filter the cards based on their 'convertedManaCost' and 'power' from the 'cards' table, and also filter the cards based on set name from the 'sets' table using the 'code' column to join with 'cards' table. The 'power' column contains the power of the card, with '*' representing unknown power. The 'convertedManaCost' column contains the converted mana cost.

# Table: cards
[
(id:INTEGER, Primary Key, Examples: [41138, 1349, 23810, 6241, 29566]),
(artist:TEXT, Description: The name of the artist that illustrated the card art., Examples: [Pete Venters, Volkan Baǵa, Justin Sweet, Matthew D. Wilson, Rebecca Guay]),
(asciiName:TEXT, Description: The ASCII(opens new window) (Basic/128) code formatted card name with no special unicode characters., Examples: [El-Hajjaj, Junun Efreet, Dandan, Ghazban Ogre]),
(availability:TEXT, Description: A list of the card's available printing types. Value Explanation: "arena", "dreamcast", "mtgo", "paper", "shandalar", Examples: [mtgo,paper, paper, arena, arena,mtgo,paper, arena,paper]),
(borderColor:TEXT, Description: The color of the card border. Value Explanation: "black", "borderless", "gold", "silver", "white", Examples: [black, white, borderless, silver, gold]),
(cardKingdomFoilId:TEXT, Description: card Kingdom Foil Id Value Explanation: cardKingdomFoilId, when paired with cardKingdomId that is not Null, is incredibly powerful., Examples: [123094, 123095, 123096, 123097]),
(cardKingdomId:TEXT, Description: card Kingdom Id Value Explanation: A list of all the colors in the color indicator, Examples: [122719, 122720, 122725, 122726, 122727]),
(colorIdentity:TEXT, Description: A list of all the colors found in manaCost, colorIndicator, and text, Examples: [W, B, U, R, G]),
(colorIndicator:TEXT, Description: A list of all the colors in the color indicator (The symbol prefixed to a card's types)., Examples: [U, G, R, B]),
(colors:TEXT, Description: A list of all the colors in manaCost and colorIndicator. Value Explanation: Some cards may not have values, such as cards with "Devoid" in its text., Examples: [W, B, U, R, G]),
(convertedManaCost:REAL, Description: The converted mana cost of the card. Use the manaValue property. Value Explanation: if value is higher, it means that this card cost more converted mana, Examples: [7.0, 5.0, 4.0, 1.0, 6.0]),
(duelDeck:TEXT, Description: The indicator for which duel deck the card is in., Examples: [a, b]),
(edhrecRank:INTEGER, Description: The card rank on EDHRec, Examples: [15650, 12702, 11081, 12901, 3988]),
(faceConvertedManaCost:REAL, Description: The converted mana cost or mana value for the face for either half or part of the card. Value Explanation: if value is higher, it means that this card cost more converted mana for the face, Examples: [4.0, 5.0, 6.0, 3.0]),
(faceName:TEXT, Description: The name on the face of the card., Examples: [Dusk, Dawn, Commit, Memory]),
(flavorName:TEXT, Description: The promotional card name printed above the true card name on special cards that has no game function. Value Explanation: The promotional card name printed above the true card name on special cards that has no game function., Examples: [Godzilla, King of the Monsters]),
(flavorText:TEXT, Description: The italicized text found below the rules text that has no game function. Value Explanation: The italicized text found below the rules text that has no game function.),
(frameEffects:TEXT, Description: The visual frame effects. Value Explanation: "colorshifted", "companion", "compasslanddfc", "devoid", "draft", "etched", "extendedart", "fullart", "inverted", "legendary", "lesson", "miracle", "mooneldrazidfc", "nyxtouched", "originpwdfc", "showcase", "snow", "sunmoondfc", "textless", "tombstone", "waxingandwaningmoondfc", Examples: [legendary, nyxtouched, miracle, devoid]),
(frameVersion:TEXT, Description: The version of the card frame style. Value Explanation: "1993", "1997", "2003", "2015", "future", Examples: [2003, 1993, 2015, 1997, future]),
(hand:TEXT, Description: The starting maximum hand size total modifier. Value Explanation: A + or - character precedes an integer.   positive maximum hand size => +1, +2, .... negative maximum hand size => -1, .... neural maximum hand size => 0...., Examples: [1, 0, -2, -1]),
(hasAlternativeDeckLimit:INTEGER, Description: If the card allows a value other than 4 copies in a deck. Value Explanation: 0: disallow 1: allow, Examples: [0, 1]),
(hasContentWarning:INTEGER, Description: If the card marked by Wizards of the Coast (opens new window) for having sensitive content. See this official article (opens new window) for more information. Value Explanation: 0: doesn't have 1: has sensitve content or Wizards of the Coast  Cards with this property may have missing or degraded properties and values., Examples: [0, 1]),
(hasFoil:INTEGER, Description: If the card can be found in foil Value Explanation: 0: cannot be found 1: can be found, Examples: [0, 1]),
(hasNonFoil:INTEGER, Description: If the card can be found in non-foil Value Explanation: 0: cannot be found 1: can be found, Examples: [1, 0]),
(isAlternative:INTEGER, Description: If the card is an alternate variation to an original printing Value Explanation: 0: is not 1: is, Examples: [0, 1]),
(isFullArt:INTEGER, Description: If the card has full artwork. Value Explanation: 0: doesn't have, 1: has full artwork, Examples: [0, 1]),
(isOnlineOnly:INTEGER, Description: If the card is only available in online game variations. Value Explanation: 0: is not 1: is, Examples: [0, 1]),
(isOversized:INTEGER, Description: If the card is oversized. Value Explanation: 0: is not 1: is, Examples: [0, 1]),
(isPromo:INTEGER, Description: If the card is a promotional printing. Value Explanation: 0: is not 1: is, Examples: [0, 1]),
(isReprint:INTEGER, Description: If the card has been reprinted. Value Explanation: 0: has not 1: has not been, Examples: [1, 0]),
(isReserved:INTEGER, Description: If the card is on the Magic: The Gathering Reserved List (opens new window) Value Explanation: If the card is on the Magic, it will appear in The Gathering Reserved List, Examples: [0, 1]),
(isStarter:INTEGER, Description: If the card is found in a starter deck such as Planeswalker/Brawl decks. Value Explanation: 0: is not 1: is, Examples: [0, 1]),
(isStorySpotlight:INTEGER, Description: If the card is a Story Spotlight card. Value Explanation: 0: is not 1: is, Examples: [0, 1]),
(isTextless:INTEGER, Description: If the card does not have a text box. Value Explanation: 0: has a text box; 1: doesn't have a text box;, Examples: [0, 1]),
(isTimeshifted:INTEGER, Description: If the card is time shifted Value Explanation: If the card is "timeshifted", a feature of certain sets where a card will have a different frameVersion., Examples: [0, 1]),
(keywords:TEXT, Description: A list of keywords found on the card., Examples: [First strike, Flying, First strike,Flash, Enchant]),
(layout:TEXT, Description: The type of card layout. For a token card, this will be "token", Examples: [normal, aftermath, split, flip, leveler]),
(leadershipSkills:TEXT, Description: A list of formats the card is legal to be a commander in),
(life:TEXT, Description: The starting life total modifier. A plus or minus character precedes an integer., Examples: [-5, -1, 2, 5]),
(loyalty:TEXT, Description: The starting loyalty value of the card. Value Explanation: Used only on cards with "Planeswalker" in its types. empty means unkown, Examples: [6, 3, 4, 5]),
(manaCost:TEXT, Description: The mana cost of the card wrapped in brackets for each value. Value Explanation: manaCost is unconverted mana cost, Examples: [{5}{W}{W}, {4}{W}, {3}{W}, {W}, {5}{W}]),
(mcmId:TEXT, Examples: [16165, 16166, 16171, 16172, 16173]),
(mcmMetaId:TEXT, Examples: [156, 176, 368, 423, 432]),

(mtgoFoilId:TEXT, Examples: [27501, 26993, 27473, 27327, 27095]),

(multiverseId:TEXT, Examples: [130550, 129465, 129470, 129477, 132106]),

(number:TEXT, Description: The number of the card, Examples: [1, 2, 7, 8, 9]),

(originalText:TEXT, Description: original Text Value Explanation: The text on the card as originally printed.),

(otherFaceIds:TEXT, Description: other Face Ids Value Explanation: A list of card UUID's to this card's counterparts, such as transformed or melded faces., Examples: [87f0062a-8321-5c16-960e-a12ce1df5839]),
(power:TEXT, Description: The power of the card. Value Explanation: ∞ means infinite power / null or * refers to unknown power, Examples: [4, 3, 2, 1]),
(printings:TEXT, Description: A list of set printing codes the card was printed in, formatted in uppercase.),
(promoTypes:TEXT, Description: A list of promotional types for a card. (purchaseUrls:TEXT, Description: Links that navigate to websites where the card can be purchased.),
(rarity:TEXT, Description: The card printing rarity., Examples: [uncommon, common, rare, mythic]),
(scryfallId:TEXT, Examples: [7a5cd03c-4227-4551-aa4b-7d119f0468b5]),
(scryfallIllustrationId:TEXT, Examples: [be2f7173-c8b7-4172-a388-9b2c6b3c16e5]),
(scryfallOracleId:TEXT, Examples: [fc2ccab7-cab1-4463-b73d-898070136d74]),
(setCode:TEXT, Description: The set printing code that the card is from., Examples: [10E, 2ED, 2XM, 3ED, 4BB]),
(side:TEXT, Description: The identifier of the card side. Value Explanation: Used on cards with multiple faces on the same card.  if this value is empty, then it means this card doesn't have multiple faces on the same card., Examples: [a, b, c, d]),
(subtypes:TEXT, Description: A list of card subtypes found after em-dash., Examples: [Human,Cleric, Angel, Bird,Soldier, Human,Rebel]),
(supertypes:TEXT, Description: A list of card supertypes found before em-dash. Value Explanation: list of all types should be the union of subtypes and supertypes, Examples: [Legendary, Basic, Legendary,Snow, World]),
(tcgplayerProductId:TEXT, Examples: [15032, 15033, 15045, 15048, 15049]),
(text:TEXT, Description: The rules text of the card.),
(toughness:TEXT, Description: The toughness of the card., Examples: [4, 3, 2, 1]),
(type:TEXT, Description: The type of the card as visible, including any supertypes and subtypes. (types:TEXT, Description: A list of all card types of the card, including Un‑sets and gameplay variants., Examples: [Creature, Instant, Enchantment, Sorcery, Artifact]),
(uuid:TEXT, Description: The universal unique identifier (v5) generated by MTGJSON. Each entry is unique., Examples: [00010d56-fe38-5e35-8aed-518019aa36a5]),
(variations:TEXT, Examples: [b7c19924-b4bf-56fc-aa73-f586e940bd42]),

]

CREATE TABLE cards (

    id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    artist TEXT -- Column Description: The name of the artist that illustrated the card art.,
    asciiName TEXT -- Column Description: The ASCII(opens new window) (Basic/128) code formatted card name with no special unicode characters.,
    availability TEXT -- Column Description: A list of the card's available printing types., Column Value Explanation: "arena", "dreamcast", "mtgo", "paper", "shandalar",
    borderColor TEXT -- Column Description: The color of the card border., Column Value Explanation: "black", "borderless", "gold", "silver", "white",
    cardKingdomFoilId TEXT -- Column Description: card Kingdom Foil Id, Column Value Explanation: cardKingdomFoilId, when paired with cardKingdomId that is not Null, is incredibly powerful.,
    cardKingdomId TEXT -- Column Description: card Kingdom Id, Column Value Explanation: A list of all the colors in the color indicator,
    colorIdentity TEXT -- Column Description: A list of all the colors found in manaCost, colorIndicator, and text,
    colorIndicator TEXT -- Column Description: A list of all the colors in the color indicator (The symbol prefixed to a card's types).,
    colors TEXT -- Column Description: A list of all the colors in manaCost and colorIndicator., Column Value Explanation: Some cards may not have values, such as cards with "Devoid" in its text.,
    convertedManaCost REAL -- Column Description: The converted mana cost of the card. Use the manaValue property., Column Value Explanation: if value is higher, it means that this card cost more converted mana,
    duelDeck TEXT -- Column Description: The indicator for which duel deck the card is in.,
    edhrecRank INTEGER -- Column Description: The card rank on EDHRec,
    faceConvertedManaCost REAL -- Column Description: The converted mana cost or mana value for the face for either half or part of the card., Column Value Explanation: if value is higher, it means that this card cost more converted mana for the face,
    faceName TEXT -- Column Description: The name on the face of the card.,
    flavorName TEXT -- Column Description: The promotional card name printed above the true card name on special cards that has no game function., Column Value Explanation: The promotional card name printed above the true card name on special cards that has no game function.,
    flavorText TEXT -- Column Description: The italicized text found below the rules text that has no game function., Column Value Explanation: The italicized text found below the rules text that has no game function.,
    frameEffects TEXT -- Column Description: The visual frame effects., Column Value Explanation: "colorshifted", "companion", "compasslanddfc", "devoid", "draft", "etched", "extendedart", "fullart", "inverted", "legendary", "lesson", "miracle", "mooneldrazidfc", "nyxtouched", "originpwdfc", "showcase", "snow", "sunmoondfc", "textless", "tombstone", "waxingandwaningmoondfc",
    frameVersion TEXT -- Column Description: The version of the card frame style., Column Value Explanation: "1993", "1997", "2003", "2015", "future",
    hand TEXT -- Column Description: The starting maximum hand size total modifier., Column Value Explanation: A + or - character precedes an integer.   positive maximum hand size => +1, +2, .... negative maximum hand size => -1, .... neural maximum hand size => 0....,
    hasAlternativeDeckLimit INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the card allows a value other than 4 copies in a deck., Column Value Explanation: 0: disallow 1: allow,
    hasContentWarning INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the card marked by Wizards of the Coast (opens new window) for having sensitive content. See this official article (opens new window) for more information., Column Value Explanation: 0: doesn't have 1: has sensitve content or Wizards of the Coast  Cards with this property may have missing or degraded properties and values.,
    hasFoil INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the card can be found in foil, Column Value Explanation: 0: cannot be found 1: can be found,
    hasNonFoil INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the card can be found in non-foil, Column Value Explanation: 0: cannot be found 1: can be found,
    isAlternative INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the card is an alternate variation to an original printing, Column Value Explanation: 0: is not 1: is,
    isFullArt INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the card has full artwork., Column Value Explanation: 0: doesn't have, 1: has full artwork,
    isOnlineOnly INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the card is only available in online game variations., Column Value Explanation: 0: is not 1: is,
    isOversized INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the card is oversized., Column Value Explanation: 0: is not 1: is,
    isPromo INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the card is a promotional printing., Column Value Explanation: 0: is not 1: is,
    isReprint INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the card has been reprinted., Column Value Explanation: 0: has not 1: has not been,
    isReserved INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the card is on the Magic: The Gathering Reserved List (opens new window), Column Value Explanation: If the card is on the Magic, it will appear in The Gathering Reserved List,
    isStarter INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the card is found in a starter deck such as Planeswalker/Brawl decks., Column Value Explanation: 0: is not 1: is,
    isStorySpotlight INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the card is a Story Spotlight card., Column Value Explanation: 0: is not 1: is,
    isTextless INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the card does not have a text box., Column Value Explanation: 0: has a text box; 1: doesn't have a text box;,
    isTimeshifted INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the card is time shifted, Column Value Explanation: If the card is "timeshifted", a feature of certain sets where a card will have a different frameVersion.,
    keywords TEXT -- Column Description: A list of keywords found on the card.,
    layout TEXT -- Column Description: The type of card layout. For a token card, this will be "token",
    leadershipSkills TEXT -- Column Description: A list of formats the card is legal to be a commander in,
    life TEXT -- Column Description: The starting life total modifier. A plus or minus character precedes an integer.,
    loyalty TEXT -- Column Description: The starting loyalty value of the card., Column Value Explanation: Used only on cards with "Planeswalker" in its types. empty means unkown,
    manaCost TEXT -- Column Description: The mana cost of the card wrapped in brackets for each value., Column Value Explanation: manaCost is unconverted mana cost,
    mcmId TEXT,
    mcmMetaId TEXT,
    mtgArenaId TEXT,
    mtgjsonV4Id TEXT,
    mtgoFoilId TEXT,
    mtgoId TEXT,
    multiverseId TEXT,
    name TEXT -- Column Description: The name of the card., Column Value Explanation: Cards with multiple faces, like "Split" and "Meld" cards are given a delimiter.,
    number TEXT -- Column Description: The number of the card,
    originalReleaseDate TEXT -- Column Description: original Release Date, Column Value Explanation: The original release date in ISO 8601(opens new window) format for a promotional card printed outside of a cycle window, such as Secret Lair Drop promotions.,
    originalText TEXT -- Column Description: original Text, Column Value Explanation: The text on the card as originally printed.,
    originalType TEXT -- Column Description: original Type, Column Value Explanation: The type of the card as originally printed. Includes any supertypes and subtypes.,
    otherFaceIds TEXT -- Column Description: other Face Ids, Column Value Explanation: A list of card UUID's to this card's counterparts, such as transformed or melded faces.,
    power TEXT -- Column Description: The power of the card., Column Value Explanation: ∞ means infinite power / null or * refers to unknown power,
    printings TEXT -- Column Description: A list of set printing codes the card was printed in, formatted in uppercase.,
    promoTypes TEXT -- Column Description: A list of promotional types for a card., Column Value Explanation: "arenaleague", "boosterfun", "boxtopper", "brawldeck", "bundle", "buyabox", "convention", "datestamped", "draculaseries", "draftweekend", "duels", "event", "fnm", "gameday", "gateway", "giftbox", "gilded", "godzillaseries", "instore", "intropack", "jpwalker", "judgegift", "league", "mediainsert", "neonink", "openhouse", "planeswalkerstamped", "playerrewards", "playpromo", "premiereshop", "prerelease", "promopack", "release", "setpromo", "stamped", "textured", "themepack", "thick", "tourney", "wizardsplaynetwork",
    purchaseUrls TEXT -- Column Description: Links that navigate to websites where the card can be purchased.,
    rarity TEXT -- Column Description: The card printing rarity.,
    scryfallId TEXT,
    scryfallIllustrationId TEXT,
    scryfallOracleId TEXT,
    setCode TEXT -- Column Description: The set printing code that the card is from.,
    side TEXT -- Column Description: The identifier of the card side., Column Value Explanation: Used on cards with multiple faces on the same card.  if this value is empty, then it means this card doesn't have multiple faces on the same card.,
    subtypes TEXT -- Column Description: A list of card subtypes found after em-dash.,
    supertypes TEXT -- Column Description: A list of card supertypes found before em-dash., Column Value Explanation: list of all types should be the union of subtypes and supertypes,
    tcgplayerProductId TEXT,
    text TEXT -- Column Description: The rules text of the card.,
    toughness TEXT -- Column Description: The toughness of the card.,
    type TEXT -- Column Description: The type of the card as visible, including any supertypes and subtypes., Column Value Explanation: "Artifact", "Card", "Conspiracy", "Creature", "Dragon", "Dungeon", "Eaturecray", "Elemental", "Elite", "Emblem", "Enchantment", "Ever", "Goblin", "Hero", "Instant", "Jaguar", "Knights", "Land", "Phenomenon", "Plane", "Planeswalker", "Scariest", "Scheme", "See", "Sorcery", "Sticker", "Summon", "Token", "Tribal", "Vanguard", "Wolf", "You’ll", "instant",
    types TEXT -- Column Description: A list of all card types of the card, including Un‑sets and gameplay variants.,
    uuid TEXT NOT NULL -- Column Description: The universal unique identifier (v5) generated by MTGJSON. Each entry is unique.,
    variations TEXT,
    watermark TEXT -- Column Description: The name of the watermark on the card.,
    PRIMARY KEY (id)

);

CREATE TABLE foreign_data (

    id INTEGER NOT NULL -- Column Description: unique id number identifying this row of data,
    flavorText TEXT -- Column Description: The foreign flavor text of the card.,
    language TEXT -- Column Description: The foreign language of card.,
    multiverseid INTEGER -- Column Description: The foreign multiverse identifier of the card.,
    name TEXT -- Column Description: The foreign name of the card.,
    text TEXT -- Column Description: The foreign text ruling of the card.,
    type TEXT -- Column Description: The foreign type of the card. Includes any supertypes and subtypes.,
    uuid TEXT,
    PRIMARY KEY (id),
    CONSTRAINT fk_foreign_data_uuid FOREIGN KEY (uuid) REFERENCES cards (uuid)

);

CREATE TABLE legalities (

    id INTEGER NOT NULL -- Column Description: unique id identifying this legality,
    format TEXT -- Column Description: format of play, Column Value Explanation: each value refers to different rules to play,
    status TEXT -- , Column Value Explanation: legal / banned /restricted,
    uuid TEXT,
    PRIMARY KEY (id),
    CONSTRAINT fk_legalities_uuid FOREIGN KEY (uuid) REFERENCES cards (uuid)

);

CREATE TABLE rulings (

    id INTEGER NOT NULL -- Column Description: unique id identifying this ruling,
    date DATE -- Column Description: date,
    text TEXT -- Column Description: description about this ruling,
    uuid TEXT,
    PRIMARY KEY (id),
    CONSTRAINT fk_rulings_uuid FOREIGN KEY (uuid) REFERENCES cards (uuid)

);

CREATE TABLE set_translations (

    id INTEGER NOT NULL -- Column Description: unique id identifying this set,
    language TEXT -- Column Description: language of this card set,
    setCode TEXT -- Column Description: the set code for this set,
    translation TEXT -- Column Description: translation of this card set,
    PRIMARY KEY (id),
    CONSTRAINT fk_set_translations_setCode FOREIGN KEY (setCode) REFERENCES sets (code)

);

CREATE TABLE sets (

    id INTEGER NOT NULL -- Column Description: unique id identifying this set,
    baseSetSize INTEGER -- Column Description: The number of cards in the set.,
    block TEXT -- Column Description: The block name the set was in.,
    booster TEXT -- Column Description: A breakdown of possibilities and weights of cards in a booster pack.,
    code TEXT NOT NULL -- Column Description: The set code for the set.,
    isFoilOnly INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the set is only available in foil.,
    isForeignOnly INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the set is available only outside the United States of America.,
    isNonFoilOnly INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the set is only available in non-foil.,
    isOnlineOnly INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the set is only available in online game variations.,
    isPartialPreview INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the set is still in preview (spoiled). Preview sets do not have complete data.,
    keyruneCode TEXT -- Column Description: The matching Keyrune code for set image icons.,
    mcmId INTEGER -- Column Description: The Magic Card Marketset identifier.,
    mcmIdExtras INTEGER -- Column Description: The split Magic Card Market set identifier if a set is printed in two sets. This identifier represents the second set's identifier.,
    mcmName TEXT,
    mtgoCode TEXT -- Column Description: The set code for the set as it appears on Magic: The Gathering Online, Column Value Explanation: if the value is null or empty, then it doesn't appear on Magic: The Gathering Online,
    name TEXT -- Column Description: The name of the set.,
    parentCode TEXT -- Column Description: The parent set code for set variations like promotions, guild kits, etc.,
    releaseDate DATE -- Column Description: The release date in ISO 8601 format for the set.,
    tcgplayerGroupId INTEGER -- Column Description: The group identifier of the set on TCGplayer,
    totalSetSize INTEGER -- Column Description: The total number of cards in the set, including promotional and related supplemental products but excluding Alchemy modifications - however those cards are included in the set itself.,
    type TEXT -- Column Description: The expansion type of the set., Column Value Explanation: "alchemy", "archenemy", "arsenal", "box", "commander", "core", "draft_innovation", "duel_deck", "expansion", "from_the_vault", "funny", "masterpiece", "masters", "memorabilia", "planechase", "premium_deck", "promo", "spellbook", "starter", "token", "treasure_chest", "vanguard",
    PRIMARY KEY (id)

);

schema_representation.execution_plan: Execution plan: The question asks for the Italian text rulings of cards from the Coldsnap set. Therefore, we need to join the `foreign_data` table (which contains foreign language text rulings) with the `cards` table (to link to the card information) and the `sets` table (to filter by set name) and `set_translations` table(to filter by set name). The `foreign_data` table is joined with `cards` table using the `uuid` column, and `set_translations` table is joined with `sets` table on the `setCode` column. We need to filter on `sets.name` for 'Coldsnap' and `foreign_data.language` for 'Italian'. The `text` column from the `foreign_data` table is the ruling text.

sql_exec_info.sql: SELECT T2."text" FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN foreign_data AS T2 ON T1."uuid" = T2."uuid" INNER JOIN sets AS T3 ON T1."setCode" = T3."code" WHERE T3."name" = 'Coldsnap' AND T2."language" = 'Italian'

CREATE TABLE foreign_data (

    id INTEGER NOT NULL -- Column Description: unique id number identifying this row of data,
    flavorText TEXT -- Column Description: The foreign flavor text of the card.,
    language TEXT -- Column Description: The foreign language of card.,
    multiverseid INTEGER -- Column Description: The foreign multiverse identifier of the card.,
    name TEXT -- Column Description: The foreign name of the card.,

    type TEXT -- Column Description: The foreign type of the card. Includes any supertypes and subtypes.,
    uuid TEXT,
    PRIMARY KEY (id),

CREATE TABLE set_translations (

    PRIMARY KEY (id),

);

);
schema_representation.execution_plan: Execution plan: The question asks for the Italian text rulings of cards from the Coldsnap set. Therefore, we need to join the `foreign_data` table (which contains foreign language text rulings) with the `cards` table (to link to the card information) and the `sets` table (to filter by set name) and `set_translations` table(to filter by set name). The `foreign_data` table is joined with `cards` table using the `uuid` column, and `set_translations` table is joined with `sets` table on the `setCode` column. We need to filter on `sets.name` for 'Coldsnap' and `foreign_data.language` for 'Italian'. The `text` column from the `foreign_data` table is the ruling text.

schema_representation.execution_plan: Execution plan: The question asks for the Italian text rulings of cards from the Coldsnap set. Therefore, we need to join the `foreign_data` table (which contains foreign language text rulings) with the `cards` table (to link to the card information) and the `sets` table (to filter by set name) and `set_translations` table(to filter by set name). The `foreign_data` table is joined with `cards` table using the `uuid` column, and `set_translations` table is joined with `sets` table on the `setCode` column. We need to filter on `sets.name` for 'Coldsnap' and `foreign_data.language` for 'Italian'. The `text` column from the `foreign_data` table is the ruling text.

sql_exec_info.sql:
SELECT T1.text
FROM foreign_data AS T1
INNER JOIN cards AS T2
  ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid
INNER JOIN sets AS T3
  ON T2.setCode = T3.code
WHERE
  T1.language = 'Italian' AND T3.name = 'Coldsnap';

schema_representation.execution_plan: Execution plan: The question asks for the Italian text ruling of cards in the 'Coldsnap' set. This requires joining the `cards` table with the `set_translations` table to filter by set name and the `foreign_data` table to filter by language. The `foreign_data` table contains the translated text ruling, and the `sets` table is needed to link the set code to the set name 'Coldsnap'. The `set_translations` table is also needed to link the set code to the language 'Italian'. Therefore, we need to join `cards` to `sets` (via `setCode`), and `cards` to `foreign_data` (via `uuid`), and `sets` to `set_translations` (via `setCode`). The `sets.name` column will be used to filter for 'Coldsnap', and `foreign_data.language` will be used to filter for 'Italian'. The `foreign_data.text` column will be the output for the text ruling.

sql_exec_info.sql: SELECT T3."text" FROM sets AS T1 INNER JOIN cards AS T2 ON T1."code" = T2."setCode" INNER JOIN foreign_data AS T3 ON T2."uuid" = T3."uuid" WHERE T1."name" = 'Coldsnap' AND T3."language" = 'Italian'

CREATE TABLE cards (

    id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    artist TEXT -- Column Description: The name of the artist that illustrated the card art.,
    asciiName TEXT -- Column Description: The ASCII(opens new window) (Basic/128) code formatted card name with no special unicode characters.,
    availability TEXT -- Column Description: A list of the card's available printing types., Column Value Explanation: "arena", "dreamcast", "mtgo", "paper", "shandalar",
    borderColor TEXT -- Column Description: The color of the card border., Column Value Explanation: "black", "borderless", "gold", "silver", "white",
    cardKingdomFoilId TEXT -- Column Description: card Kingdom Foil Id, Column Value Explanation: cardKingdomFoilId, when paired with cardKingdomId that is not Null, is incredibly powerful.,
    cardKingdomId TEXT -- Column Description: card Kingdom Id, Column Value Explanation: A list of all the colors in the color indicator,
    colorIdentity TEXT -- Column Description: A list of all the colors found in manaCost, colorIndicator, and text,
    colorIndicator TEXT -- Column Description: A list of all the colors in the color indicator (The symbol prefixed to a card's types).,
    colors TEXT -- Column Description: A list of all the colors in manaCost and colorIndicator., Column Value Explanation: Some cards may not have values, such as cards with "Devoid" in its text.,
    convertedManaCost REAL -- Column Description: The converted mana cost of the card. Use the manaValue property., Column Value Explanation: if value is higher, it means that this card cost more converted mana,
    duelDeck TEXT -- Column Description: The indicator for which duel deck the card is in.,
    edhrecRank INTEGER -- Column Description: The card rank on EDHRec,
    faceConvertedManaCost REAL -- Column Description: The converted mana cost or mana value for the face for either half or part of the card., Column Value Explanation: if value is higher, it means that this card cost more converted mana for the face,

CREATE TABLE foreign_data (

    id INTEGER NOT NULL -- Column Description: unique id number identifying this row of data,
    flavorText TEXT -- Column Description: The foreign flavor text of the card.,
    language TEXT -- Column Description: The foreign language of card.,
    multiverseid INTEGER -- Column Description: The foreign multiverse identifier of the card.,
    name TEXT -- Column Description: The foreign name of the card.,

CREATE TABLE set_translations (

);

This requires joining the `cards` table with the `set_translations` table to filter by set name and the `foreign_data` table to filter by language. The `foreign_data` table contains the translated text ruling, and the `sets` table is needed to link the set code to the set name 'Coldsnap'. The `set_translations` table is also needed to link the set code to the language 'Italian'. Therefore, we need to join `cards` to `sets` (via `setCode`), and `cards` to `foreign_data` (via `uuid`), and `sets` to `set_translations` (via `setCode`). The `sets.name` column will be used to filter for 'Coldsnap', and `foreign_data.language` will be used to filter for 'Italian'. The `foreign_data.text` column will be the output for the text ruling.

sql_exec_info.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT T1."text"
FROM foreign_data AS T1
INNER JOIN set_translations AS T2
  ON T1."language" = T2."language"
INNER JOIN sets AS T3
  ON T2."setCode" = T3."code"
WHERE T1."language" = 'Italian' AND T3."name" = 'Coldsnap';

schema_representation.execution_plan: Execution plan: The question asks for the Italian text ruling of cards in the 'Coldsnap' set. This requires joining the `cards` table with the `set_translations` table to filter by set name and the `foreign_data` table to filter by language. The `foreign_data` table contains the translated text ruling, and the `sets` table is needed to link the set code to the set name 'Coldsnap'. The `set_translations` table is also needed to link the set code to the language 'Italian'. Therefore, we need to join `cards` to `sets` (via `setCode`), and `cards` to `foreign_data` (via `uuid`), and `sets` to `set_translations` (via `setCode`). The `sets.name` column will be used to filter for 'Coldsnap', and `foreign_data.language` will be used to filter for 'Italian'. The `foreign_data.text` column will be the output for the text ruling.

sql_exec_info.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT T1."text"
FROM foreign_data AS T1
INNER JOIN set_translations AS T2 ON T1."uuid" = T2."setCode"
INNER JOIN sets AS T3 ON T2."setCode" = T3."name"
WHERE T1."language" = 'Italian' AND T3."name" = 'Coldsnap';

preliminary_sql:
SELECT
  T1."name"
FROM foreign_data AS T1
INNER JOIN cards AS T2
  ON T1.multiverseid = T2.multiverseId
INNER JOIN set_translations AS T3
  ON T2."setCode" = T3."setCode"
INNER JOIN sets AS T4
  ON T3."setCode" = T4."code"
WHERE
  T1.language = 'Italian' AND T4."name" = 'Coldsnap'
ORDER BY
  T2.convertedManaCost DESC
LIMIT 1;

sql_exec_info.sql:
SELECT T1.name
FROM foreign_data AS T1
INNER JOIN cards AS T2
  ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid
INNER JOIN sets AS T3
  ON T2.setCode = T3.code
WHERE
  T3.name = 'Coldsnap' AND T1.language = 'Italian' AND T2.convertedManaCost = (
    SELECT
      MAX(T2_sub.convertedManaCost)
    FROM foreign_data AS T1_sub
    INNER JOIN cards AS T2_sub
      ON T1_sub.uuid = T2_sub.uuid
    INNER JOIN sets AS T3_sub
      ON T2_sub.setCode = T3_sub.code
    WHERE
      T3_sub.name = 'Coldsnap' AND T1_sub.language = 'Italian'
  );

schema_representation.execution_plan: Execution plan: The question requires finding the Italian names of cards from the 'Coldsnap' set with the highest converted mana cost. This involves joining the `cards`, `foreign_data`, and `sets` tables. The `cards` table is needed for the `convertedManaCost`. The `foreign_data` table is needed to filter by Italian names. The `sets` table is needed to filter by the set name 'Coldsnap'. The `setCode` column is used to join `cards` and `sets` tables, and the `setCode` column is used to join `cards` and `set_translations` tables.  The `foreign_data` and `cards` tables are joined using the `uuid` column. Finally, the query needs to find the maximum converted mana cost.

sql_exec_info.sql:
SELECT T3."name"
FROM cards AS T1
INNER JOIN sets AS T2
  ON T1."setCode" = T2."code"
INNER JOIN foreign_data AS T3
  ON T1."uuid" = T3."uuid"
WHERE
  T2."name" = 'Coldsnap' AND T3."language" = 'Italian' AND T1."convertedManaCost" = (
    SELECT
      MAX(T4."convertedManaCost")
    FROM cards AS T4
    INNER JOIN sets AS T5
      ON T4."setCode" = T5."code"
    WHERE
      T5."name" = 'Coldsnap'
  );

schema_representation.execution_plan: Execution plan: The question requires finding the Italian names of cards from the 'Coldsnap' set with the highest converted mana cost. This involves joining the `cards`, `foreign_data`, and `sets` tables. The `cards` table is needed for the `convertedManaCost`. The `foreign_data` table is needed to filter by Italian names. The `sets` table is needed to filter by the set name 'Coldsnap'. The `setCode` column is used to join `cards` and `sets` tables, and the `setCode` column is used to join `cards` and `set_translations` tables.  The `foreign_data` and `cards` tables are joined using the `uuid` column. Finally, the query needs to find the maximum converted mana cost.

sql_exec_info.sql:
SELECT T2.name
        FROM cards AS T1
        INNER JOIN foreign_data AS T2
          ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid
        INNER JOIN sets AS T3
          ON T1.setCode = T3.code
        WHERE T3.name = 'Coldsnap' AND T2.language = 'Italian' AND T1.convertedManaCost = (
          SELECT MAX(T1_sub."convertedManaCost")
          FROM cards AS T1_sub
          INNER JOIN foreign_data AS T2_sub
            ON T1_sub.uuid = T2_sub.uuid
          INNER JOIN sets AS T3_sub
            ON T1_sub.setCode = T3_sub.code
          WHERE T3_sub.name = 'Coldsnap' AND T2_sub.language = 'Italian'
        )

2. Filter the results for the language 'Italian'.
3. Determine the maximum `convertedManaCost` among these cards.
4. Filter the cards to include only those with the maximum `convertedManaCost`.
5. Select the `name` from the `foreign_data` table for the Italian translation.

Therefore, the essential columns are:
- `sets.name`: To filter for the 'Coldsnap' set.
- `set_translations.language`: To filter for the 'Italian' language.

- `cards.convertedManaCost`: To identify the highest converted mana cost.
- `cards.id`: To join with `foreign_data` and `set_translations` (assuming `uuid` is the foreign key, but `id` is the primary key for `cards`). The schema shows `foreign_data` has a `uuid` which is a foreign key to `cards.uuid`. However, `cards` table does not have a `uuid` column, but it has `id` as primary key. Assuming `foreign_data.uuid` should actually be `foreign_data.multiverseid` to join with `cards.multiverseId` or `foreign_data.id` to join with `cards.id` if `foreign_data` has an `id` column. Given the schema, the most plausible join is through `multiverseId` or `id` if `foreign_data` had an `id` column. Since `foreign_data` has `multiverseid` and `cards` has `multiverseId`, this is a potential join. However, `set_translations` has `setCode` which joins to `sets.code`. The question implies filtering by set name, so `sets.name` is needed. The Italian names are in `foreign_data.name` where `foreign_data.language` is 'Italian'. To link `cards` to `foreign_data`, we need a common identifier. `cards.multiverseId` and `foreign_data.multiverseid` seem to be the intended link. `set_translations` links to `sets` via `setCode`. So, we need to link `cards` to `sets` to filter by set name, and then link `cards` to `foreign_data` to get the Italian names.

SELECT T1.name
FROM foreign_data AS T1
INNER JOIN cards AS T2
  ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid
INNER JOIN sets AS T3
  ON T2.setCode = T3.code
WHERE
  T3.name = 'Coldsnap' AND T1.language = 'Italian' AND T2.convertedManaCost = (
    SELECT
      MAX(T2_sub.convertedManaCost)
    FROM foreign_data AS T1_sub
    INNER JOIN cards AS T2_sub
      ON T1_sub.uuid = T2_sub.uuid
    INNER JOIN sets AS T3_sub
      ON T2_sub.setCode = T3_sub.code
    WHERE
      T3_sub.name = 'Coldsnap' AND T1_sub.language = 'Italian'
  );

    borderColor TEXT -- Column Description: The color of the card border., Column Value Explanation: "black", "borderless", "gold", "silver", "white",

    cardKingdomId TEXT -- Column Description: card Kingdom Id, Column Value Explanation: A list of all the colors in the color indicator,
    colorIdentity TEXT -- Column Description: A list of all the colors found in manaCost, colorIndicator, and text,

    faceName TEXT -- Column Description: The name on the face of the card.,
    flavorName TEXT -- Column Description: The promotional card name printed above the true card name on special cards that has no game function., Column Value Explanation: The promotional card name printed above the true card name on special cards that has no game function.,
    flavorText TEXT -- Column Description: The italicized text found below the rules text that has no game function., Column Value Explanation: The italicized text found below the rules text that has no game function.,
    frameEffects TEXT -- Column Description: The visual frame effects., Column Value Explanation: "colorshifted", "companion", "compasslanddfc", "devoid", "draft", "etched", "extendedart", "fullart", "inverted", "legendary", "lesson", "miracle", "mooneldrazidfc", "nyxtouched", "originpwdfc", "showcase", "snow", "sunmoondfc", "textless", "tombstone", "waxingandwaningmoondfc",
    frameVersion TEXT -- Column Description: The version of the card frame style., Column Value Explanation: "1993", "1997", "2003", "2015", "future",
    hand TEXT -- Column Description: The starting maximum hand size total modifier., Column Value Explanation: A + or - character precedes an integer.   positive maximum hand size => +1, +2, .... negative maximum hand size => -1, .... neural maximum hand size => 0....,
    hasAlternativeDeckLimit INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the card allows a value other than 4 copies in a deck., Column Value Explanation: 0: disallow 1: allow,

See this official article (opens new window) for more information., Column Value Explanation: 0: doesn't have 1: has sensitve content or Wizards of the Coast  Cards with this property may have missing or degraded properties and values.,
    hasFoil INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the card can be found in foil, Column Value Explanation: 0: cannot be found 1: can be found,
    hasNonFoil INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the card can be found in non-foil, Column Value Explanation: 0: cannot be found 1: can be found,
    isAlternative INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the card is an alternate variation to an original printing, Column Value Explanation: 0: is not 1: is,
    isFullArt INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the card has full artwork., Column Value Explanation: 0: doesn't have, 1: has full artwork,
    isOnlineOnly INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the card is only available in online game variations., Column Value Explanation: 0: is not 1: is,
    isOversized INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the card is oversized., Column Value Explanation: 0: is not 1: is,

    isStarter INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the card is found in a starter deck such as Planeswalker/Brawl decks., Column Value Explanation: 0: is not 1: is,
    isStorySpotlight INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the card is a Story Spotlight card., Column Value Explanation: 0: is not 1: is,
    isTextless INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the card does not have a text box., Column Value Explanation: 0: has a text box; 1: doesn't have a text box;,
    isTimeshifted INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the card is time shifted, Column Value Explanation: If the card is "timeshifted", a feature of certain sets where a card will have a different frameVersion.,
    keywords TEXT -- Column Description: A list of keywords found on the card.,
    layout TEXT -- Column Description: The type of card layout. For a token card, this will be "token",
    leadershipSkills TEXT -- Column Description: A list of formats the card is legal to be a commander in,
    life TEXT -- Column Description: The starting life total modifier. A plus or minus character precedes an integer.,

Therefore, we need the 'cards' table and the relevant columns are 'artist', 'side', and 'convertedManaCost'.

The question asks for the illustrator of the card art with the highest converted mana cost, specifically for cards that do not have multiple faces. The `cards` table contains information about the artist, converted mana cost, and whether a card has multiple faces. The `side` column in the `cards` table can be used to filter for cards that do not have multiple faces (where `side` is NULL). The `convertedManaCost` column represents the converted mana cost, and we need to find the maximum value of this column. The `artist` column will provide the name of the illustrator.

sql_exec_info.sql:
SELECT "artist"
FROM "cards"
WHERE "side" IS NULL AND "convertedManaCost" = (
  SELECT MAX("convertedManaCost")
  FROM "cards"
  WHERE "side" IS NULL
);

    faceName TEXT -- Column Description: The name on the face of the card.,
    flavorName TEXT -- Column Description: The promotional card name printed above the true card name on special cards that has no game function., Column Value Explanation: The promotional card name printed above the true card name on special cards that has no game function.,
    flavorText TEXT -- Column Description: The italicized text found below the rules text that has no game function., Column Value Explanation: The italicized text found below the rules text that has no game function.,
    frameEffects TEXT -- Column Description: The visual frame effects., Column Value Explanation: "colorshifted", "companion", "compasslanddfc", "devoid", "draft", "etched", "extendedart", "fullart", "inverted", "legendary", "lesson", "miracle", "mooneldrazidfc", "nyxtouched", "originpwdfc", "showcase", "snow", "sunmoondfc", "textless", "tombstone", "waxingandwaningmoondfc",

See this official article (opens new window) for more information., Column Value Explanation: 0: doesn't have 1: has sensitve content or Wizards of the Coast  Cards with this property may have missing or degraded properties and values.,

    isOversized INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the card is oversized., Column Value Explanation: 0: is not 1: is,
    isPromo INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the card is a promotional printing., Column Value Explanation: 0: is not 1: is,
    isReprint INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the card has been reprinted., Column Value Explanation: 0: has not 1: has not been,
    isReserved INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the card is on the Magic: The Gathering Reserved List (opens new window), Column Value Explanation: If the card is on the Magic, it will appear in The Gathering Reserved List,

    isStorySpotlight INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the card is a Story Spotlight card., Column Value Explanation: 0: is not 1: is,
    isTextless INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the card does not have a text box., Column Value Explanation: 0: has a text box; 1: doesn't have a text box;,
    isTimeshifted INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 -- Column Description: If the card is time shifted, Column Value Explanation: If the card is "timeshifted", a feature of certain sets where a card will have a different frameVersion.,
    keywords TEXT -- Column Description: A list of keywords found on the card.,

    leadershipSkills TEXT -- Column Description: A list of formats the card is legal to be a commander in,

    *   Must return the name of the illustrator (text value).

selected_schemas.chain_of_thought_reasoning: To answer the question, we need to find the oldest mythic card and its legal play formats.  We need to filter cards by rarity='mythic' and find the minimum originalReleaseDate. Then, we need to join with the legalities table to find the legal formats for the card.  Therefore, we need columns from the cards and legalities tables.

The question asks for the release date of the oldest mythic card and its legal play formats. To find the oldest mythic card, I need to filter the 'cards' table by rarity='mythic' and then find the minimum 'originalReleaseDate'. To get the legal play formats, I need to join the 'cards' table with the 'legalities' table on the card's ID and filter the 'legalities' table by status='legal' and format. Therefore, I need 'rarity' and 'originalReleaseDate' from the 'cards' table, and 'format' and 'status' from the 'legalities' table.

sql_exec_info.sql:
SELECT T1."originalReleaseDate", T2."format"
FROM "cards" AS T1
INNER JOIN "legalities" AS T2
  ON T1."uuid" = T2."uuid"
WHERE
  T1."rarity" = 'mythic' AND T2."status" = 'Legal' AND T1."originalReleaseDate" = (
    SELECT
      MIN("originalReleaseDate")
    FROM "cards"
    WHERE
      "rarity" = 'mythic' AND "originalReleaseDate" IS NOT NULL
  );

sql_exec_info.sql:
SELECT
          T1."originalReleaseDate",
          T2."format"
        FROM "cards" AS T1
        INNER JOIN "legalities" AS T2
          ON T1."uuid" = T2."uuid"
        WHERE
          T1."uuid" = (
            SELECT
              "uuid"
            FROM "cards"
            WHERE
              "rarity" = 'mythic'
            ORDER BY
              "originalReleaseDate" ASC NULLS LAST
            LIMIT 1
          ) AND T2."status" = 'Legal';
